correctness.rationale: The claim is χ_top(A(C^n))=n!/2^floor(n/2), n≥2, for the smooth projective standard complete-skew-form compactification. For a generic one-parameter diagonal subgroup with distinct pair weights 2^i+2^j, a fixed projective first skew form has one coordinate wedge, whose kernel is the complementary coordinate subspace. Repeating on coordinate kernels gives precisely ordered disjoint unordered label-pairs, leaving a singleton for odd n. These fixed points are isolated and correspond to n!/2^floor(n/2) possible ordered pair sequences. Since the moduli is smooth projective, Bialynicki–Birula fixed-point stratification gives χ=#fixed. The n=2 case is a point, n=3 is P², both agree. Independently reconstructed exact recurrence 2≤n≤80 and pair-weight distinctness 2≤n≤30; finite checks corroborate only the symbolic argument. Git tree object and all seven named blobs were inspected.
residual_risks: Finite verifier never independently verifies smoothness or the whole fixed-point classification; the analytic proof and established smooth blow-up construction carry these facts.
No Betti-number or Poincare polynomial claim is proved.

originality.rationale: The complete all-n Euler evaluation is already implied by substantially stronger earlier primary results, despite the absence of its exact string in those papers. For even dimension 2m, Brion–Joshua Lemma 2.1.1(i) describes torus-fixed points of the wonderful compactification X of PSL(2m)/PSp(2m) as W_G/W_L. Their Example 1.4.4(2) explicitly gives W_G=S_{2m} and W_L=(S_2)^m, so |X^T|=(2m)!/2^m and smooth projective Bialynicki–Birula (or torus localization for Euler characteristic) gives the same Euler number. The open nondegenerate skew-form orbit, Thaddeus blow-up and Massarenti Proposition 3.6 identify this X with the submitted complete-skew-form variety. For odd dimension 2m+1, Borisov–Libgober Proposition 3.1 gives a flag model with first flag space F^0 a line and nondegenerate 2-forms only on successive even-dimensional quotient spaces; forgetting all but F^0 realizes the odd-dimensional space as the associated even-dimensional complete-skew-form bundle over P^{2m}, so chi_odd=(2m+1)chi_even=(2m+1)!/2^m. At n=3 this is P(Lambda² C³*)=P², Euler 3; n=2 is one point. These prior implications cover the complete claim, not merely a sample or a similar title. An independently written ordered-matching proof is a useful explanation but cannot be counted as a new theorem under this protocol.
residual_risks: The exact odd fibration is obtained by taking the first F0 from the published flag parametrization, rather than an explicit Euler formula printed in Borisov–Libgober; the local-triviality follows from the universal quotient vector bundle and GL-equivariant complete-form construction.

Brion–Joshua fixed-point result is stated for the wonderful symmetric compactification; the identification with the specific complete-skew-form blow-up uses the published Thaddeus–Massarenti correspondence.
No exhaustive bibliography of older equivalent Poincare polynomial formulas is needed to reject originality, since decisive stronger primary coverage is established.

value.rationale: The Euler characteristic of classical complete skew forms is a natural geometric quantity, and ordered pairings provide a clear exposition. However, for even dimensions its exact formula is a one-line specialization of the pre-existing Brion–Joshua Weyl quotient fixed-point theorem, and the odd case is a routine projective-bundle Euler multiplication from Borisov–Libgober Proposition 3.1. The remaining statement adds neither an independent topological invariant unknown under the literature, a nonstandard lemma, a new structural obstruction, nor a classification not automatically implied by those stronger results. As a mathematical contribution it is a useful explanatory corollary but falls below the independent-value bar; no assertion that all Euler computations are valueless.
residual_risks: A presentation of the implicit Weyl quotient count could have pedagogical value; that does not supply a new mathematical fact or new substantive method under this rubric.

limitations: The final scientific rejection is due to mathematically decisive prior coverage and lack of independent value; it does not allege an incorrect Euler formula.
